title: Block domain, search the Blocked list, change a rule's choice, Unblock
steps: Launch with -UseFakeGmail (fake mail only), open a conversation and choose Block domain from its ... menu (or Option-Shift-Command-B); ignore the cleanup toast
Cmd-K, Go to Blocked (or Settings > Blocked); type part of the domain in Search blocked
In the rule's New mail menu choose Move to Trash, then change 'By default' to Move to Trash and back
Press Unblock on the rule, then Undo beside the page's list
expected: The domain shows as '<domain> (whole domain)' with its choice under it; the search narrows the list and says when nothing matches. The rule's own choice shows Move to Trash; the default menu changes the rules without a choice. Unblock removes the rule at once; Undo (or Cmd-Z in the mail window) brings it back. A conversation's right-click menu also has Block sender and Block domain.
